summary: Only explicit where creates relational predicates; closed Rust is opaque and host-once.
Normalization preserves closed Rust operands without recognition or type-directed rewriting.
Execution placement consumes dependencies and representation rather than interpreting Rust.
Closed operands are borrowed once on the host with temporary lifetimes preserved.
Identity and encoded columns are explicit facts, never inferred from types.
Opaque Rust and generators require the compiled written-order Rust oracle.
Host captures preserve opaque device Rust and use recorded relational codecs.
Device Rust accepts only identity read columns; encoded predicates remain relational.
GPU emission consumes checked scheduling facts; unrecorded Group rerouting remains a deviation.
Reduction templates follow recorded partition and completion boundaries, not implementation stripes.
Tasks emission consumes producer, lifetime and carrier-publication facts without replanning.
Pull emission preserves recorded support, choice, store and publication decisions.
Owned decoded tuples are a P5 deviation; summaries belong with stored column payload.
Fixed FOR defaults lack controlled end-to-end evidence; codec and role choices require target measurements.
First-sight codes preserve equality only; parallel assignment is a publication decision.
Encode-time extrema currently lose max; retained logical summaries and tile decoding belong to P6.
AdaptiveKeySet staging and Arc fallback are off-design P4 work, not the future index default.
Positions are borrowed occurrence witnesses supporting exact reads and late materialization.
One-shot Build copying needs recorded reasons; grouped index runs and scan codecs have separate roles.
Selection records positional strategies and must justify pruning and role decisions with target evidence.
Layout realizes recorded allocation facts; uniform i64 carriers remain a P6 deviation.
Global Mutex first-sight codes define IStr code order; publication changes require P4 measurement.
Emit the recorded strategy; only the direct immutable load-verified host carrier licenses prefix-run sort and unique.
Admission reads the canonical index chosen by index selection and publishes into every ordinary index; no separate membership store or printer branch.
